General_Hospital_Radiology.message: SURPLUS Radio_Contrast at General_Hospital — 9 units on hand, radiology job queue currently empty. Up to 4 units available for transfer to any hospital with urgent need; reply with quantity and I will execute the transfer. Note: IV_Kits (20) and PPE_Sets (21) inventory is also high but shared with my co-located departments — I will confirm offerable quantities after checking with them.
